# openai Provider

Manage an OpenAI organization with Terraform through the Admin API.

This provider is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

## Authentication

The provider sends an Admin API key as a bearer token on every request. Set
`admin_api_key`, or leave it out and set `OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY`. Configuring
neither fails before any request is made.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    openai = {
      source = "TrogonStack/openai"
    }
  }
}

# Leave admin_api_key unset to read it from the OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY environment variable.
provider "openai" {
  admin_api_key = var.openai_admin_api_key
}

variable "openai_admin_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  default   = null
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_api_key` (String, Sensitive) An OpenAI Admin API key. Falls back to `OPENAI_ADMIN_KEY`.
- `base_url` (String) The OpenAI API base URL. Falls back to `OPENAI_BASE_URL`, then `https://api.openai.com/v1`.
